subject: a slight, thin Indian man in his early sixties with a shaved head, large ears, round wire-rimmed spectacles and a short grey moustache, wearing a plain white hand-spun cotton dhoti and a simple white shawl over one shoulder, bare-chested under the shawl, simple leather sandals, a long bamboo walking staff, calm and determined

panels.01-porbandar: the small whitewashed coastal town of Porbandar in Gujarat, western India, in 1869, narrow streets of old stone houses with carved wooden balconies, the Arabian Sea and wooden sailing dhows in the harbour, wide establishing shot, warm morning light, calm
panels.02-station: a young slender Indian lawyer in his early twenties with short black hair and a small moustache, wearing a dark Victorian frock coat, high white collar and a turban, sitting alone on a wooden bench in a cold, dimly lit colonial railway station waiting room at night in Natal, South Africa, 1893, a single gas lamp, his luggage beside him, a steam train departing beyond the window, quiet resolve
panels.03-phoenix: a moustached Indian man in his mid-thirties in shirtsleeves and a waistcoat working at a hand-operated printing press in a simple corrugated-iron shed on a farm near Durban in 1904, Indian and European helpers setting type and stacking freshly printed newspaper sheets, rural fields and huts through the open door, honest hard work
panels.04-champaran: a moustached Indian man in his late forties wearing a white kurta, dhoti and a Kathiawari turban sitting cross-legged under a large tree in a village in Bihar in 1917, writing notes on paper on a low wooden desk while barefoot indigo farmers in simple cotton clothes wait in a patient line to speak with him, indigo fields behind, focused listening
panels.05-spinning: {S} in his fifties sitting cross-legged on a woven mat on the floor of a simple ashram room in 1921, turning a wooden spinning wheel (charkha) and drawing out a fine cotton thread, baskets of raw cotton beside him, soft light through a lattice window, deep concentration
panels.06-saltmarch: {S} striding at the head of a long column of marchers in white homespun cotton clothes on a dusty country road through Gujarat villages in March 1930, villagers watching from beside the road under neem trees, the column stretching far behind, sun low on the horizon, purposeful and peaceful
panels.07-noakhali: {S} as an old man of seventy-seven walking barefoot along a narrow earthen path between rice paddies and palm trees in the Bengal countryside in late 1946, leaning on his bamboo staff, a few companions following, villagers watching quietly from a bamboo bridge, humble and calm
panels.08-rajghat: a simple square black stone memorial platform on a lawn beside the Yamuna river in Delhi at dusk, an eternal flame burning in a lamp at one end, fresh marigold garlands laid on it, mourners of different faiths in simple clothes standing in respectful silence at a distance, dignified, peaceful, no people's faces in close-up
